Class McpOAuthEndpoints

java.lang.Object
grafioschtrader.mcp.oauth.McpOAuthEndpoints
@Component @ConditionalOnProperty(prefix="gt.use", name="mcp", havingValue="true") public class McpOAuthEndpoints extends Object
Every address of the OAuth authorization of the MCP server, derived from the global parameter gt.mcp.public.base.url alone and read anew on every call, so a change by the administrator takes effect without a restart. None is ever built from the incoming request, and the two metadata locations are not appended to the base URL: RFC 9728 and RFC 8414 put the well-known part before the path, so under a path prefix both lie outside of it.
Address at the domain root under the prefix /gt
issuer https://host https://host/gt
resource https://host/api/mcp https://host/gt/api/mcp
protected resource metadata /.well-known/oauth-protected-resource/api/mcp /.well-known/oauth-protected-resource/gt/api/mcp
authorization server metadata /.well-known/oauth-authorization-server /.well-known/oauth-authorization-server/gt

Without a usable public base URL, or while the MCP server is closed (gt.mcp.use), OAuth is not offered: the metadata answer 404 and the token endpoint refuses. Personal access tokens need no base URL.
